description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Appends drafts (content ids) to the end of a queue — they will be BOOKED AND POSTED on the queue's schedule. Use `contentIds`, or `items` for a per-item YouTube title or platforms. Drafts of another brand, duplicates, archived drafts and drafts without a video for a video platform come back in `rejected`. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/queues/{id}/items.)

instanceLabels.description: Internal labels per platform/account instance. An array of {platform, accountId?, labels}; accountId is the Zernio connected account id. Omit accountId when unknown. instanceKey is derived as canonical platform + ":account:" + URL-encoded account id, or ":pending" when unknown (twitter canonicalizes to x). Replaces the instance set when editing; [] clears it. Never published.

platforms.description: Post this item to these platforms instead of the queue's.

youtubeTitle.description: The video's YouTube title. Omitted → the draft's stored title, else derived from its caption.

name: add_queue_items
title: Add drafts to a queue
